root_cause: ArrowRight increments the date by one day without skipping disabled weekend days, causing selection of closed days.
repair_strategy: Modify adjustDate to loop forward/backward by one day until a non-disabled date (respecting minDate, maxDate, disableWeekends, and disableDayFn) is found.
expected_accessibility_effect: Keyboard navigation with ArrowRight/Left/Up/Down will now skip over disabled weekend dates, ensuring users can only select valid weekdays.
functional_risks: Risk of infinite loop if all dates are disabled (unlikely). Slight performance impact due to looping; adjustDate is only used for arrow key navigation, so other functionality remains unchanged.
verification_requirements: Test that ArrowRight from Friday 2026-11-20 yields Monday 2026-11-23; ArrowLeft from Monday yields Friday; verify that arrow keys never land on Saturday or Sunday; ensure month navigation and direct date input still work.
